title: The injection grid: the Python's 500 injections through every organism, native and with Omni-Compass on native, and through every governor on each organism, at 1, 10, 100 and 500 runs and 1, 10, 100 and 500 organisms
own_runs: Run and scored by The Omni-Compass LLC's own code. No outside party has reviewed or approved these results. Preregistered means the rules were written down in our own repository before the runs; nothing was filed with any outside body.
rule: run k of a cell stacks M copies, copy c on injection k + c (mod 500); the copies are separate clusters on one clock; every gauge per muscle (the work index, the share of muscles over the line, the power per muscle; a governor's way per muscle of the organism and the governor's body together) and the mean of the copies'; each run's change per decision against its reference over 24 blocks of ten decisions with its 95% interval (Student t); the cell's word by the founder's rule of 24 October over its N runs (tools/readings.py three_run_reading)

gauges.name: share of muscles over the line

governors.name: The Kubernetes scheduler (vanilla, and its bin-packing profile)

whole: the whole organism is a composition of real measured tables (tools/whole_system.py) and takes no injection; tools/scenarios_20.py reads it, native and with Omni-Compass on native
means_note: each run's mean over its decisions, per body as the harness counts it (work index, muscles over the line, power in kW), native and with Omni-Compass on native; the cells read them per muscle (over and power divided by the body's muscles, a governor's way by the organism's and the body's together)
